title: IOE Lớp 4 - Chuyên đề 3 - Vòng Trường

part_A.question: ... you play with the yo-yo? – Yes, I can.
part_A.explanation: "Can you...? – Yes, I can." – Câu hỏi khả năng dùng "Can"; trả lời khẳng định: "Yes, I can."

part_A.question: Jenny’s birthday is ... April.
part_A.explanation: Trước tên tháng dùng giới từ "in": birthday is in April.

part_A.question: I have many ... at school.
part_A.explanation: "subjects" (số nhiều) = các môn học; "I have many subjects" = tôi có nhiều môn học.

part_A.question: Why are you happy? – ___ today is my birthday.
part_A.explanation: "Why...? – Because..." – Hỏi lý do dùng "Why"; trả lời bắt đầu bằng "Because".

part_A.question: Do you want some milk? - ... .
part_A.explanation: "Do you want...? – Yes, I do." – Câu hỏi hiện tại đơn với "do"; trả lời "Yes, I do."

part_A.question: Can you play chess, Nam? - ___.
part_A.explanation: "Can you...? – Yes, I can." – Câu hỏi khả năng; trả lời khẳng định "Yes, I can."

part_A.question: My name’s Alice. ... A-L-I-C-E.
part_A.explanation: "That's A-L-I-C-E" – dùng "That's" khi đánh vần tên: "That's + tên đánh vần."

part_A.question: June is next to July then September is next to … .
part_A.explanation: Tháng 9 (September) liền kề với tháng 10 (October); "next to" = liền kề.

part_A.question: Dad is … the bike for me.
part_A.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: is + V-ing; "repair" = sửa chữa → "is repairing".

part_A.question: Kien and Thanh did not ______ photos.
part_A.explanation: "did not" + V-nguyên thể → "did not take photos" (quá khứ phủ định).

part_A.question: We need a ... to go camping.
part_A.explanation: "a tent" = lều trại; dùng khi đi cắm trại (go camping).

part_A.question: Some cows on my farm produce ....
part_A.explanation: Bò (cows) sản xuất sữa (produce milk) – từ vựng về trang trại.

part_A.question: It’s .... Put on your raincoat.
part_A.explanation: "It's rainy" = trời đang mưa → mặc áo mưa (raincoat).

part_A.question: ... do you have Science? – On Monday.
part_A.explanation: "When do you have...? – On Monday." – Hỏi thời điểm học môn gì dùng "When".

part_A.question: What ... is this? – It’s blue.
part_A.explanation: "What colour is this?" – Hỏi màu sắc dùng "What colour".

part_A.question: There are _______ days in November.
part_A.explanation: Tháng 11 (November) có 30 ngày (thirty days).

part_A.question: Who is …, Lan or Mary?
part_A.explanation: So sánh hơn tính từ ngắn: young → younger. "Who is younger?" hỏi ai trẻ hơn.

part_A.question: Can you ride a horse, Mai? - ___
part_A.explanation: "Can you...? – Yes, I can." – Câu hỏi khả năng; trả lời khẳng định.

part_A.question: What does Mrs. Brown do? – ....
part_A.explanation: "What does she do?" – Hỏi nghề nghiệp; trả lời "She's a teacher."

part_A.question: Can Max ride a bike? - ___
part_A.explanation: "Can Max...? – No, he can't." – Câu hỏi khả năng phủ định: "No, he can't."

part_A.question: Amy didn’t learn P.E. _______.
part_A.explanation: "last Thursday" – Không dùng "on" trước "last/next + thứ": "last Thursday" (thứ Năm tuần trước).

part_A.question: ... is your birthday? – It’s in February.
part_A.explanation: "When is your birthday?" – Hỏi thời điểm sinh nhật dùng "When".

part_A.question: Would you like ... ice cream? – Yes, please.
part_A.explanation: "ice cream" bắt đầu bằng âm nguyên âm /aɪ/ → dùng "an ice cream".

part_A.question: What time do you go to … at night? – At 11:00.
part_A.explanation: "go to bed" = đi ngủ; "What time do you go to bed?" hỏi giờ đi ngủ.

part_A.question: What ... a glass of water? – Yes, please.
part_A.explanation: "What about...?" = Còn... thì sao? Dùng để đề nghị hoặc gợi ý.

part_A.question: What is his …? – He’s an architect.
part_A.explanation: "What is his job?" – Hỏi nghề nghiệp; "architect" = kiến trúc sư.

part_A.question: How many ... are there? - There are ten.
part_A.explanation: "How many + danh từ số nhiều": "How many pencils?" → "pencils" (số nhiều của pencil).

part_A.question: I … hungry. I’d like some cakes.
part_A.explanation: Chủ ngữ "I" + động từ "to be": "I am hungry."

part_A.question: ... is your mother’s birthday? – In December.
part_A.explanation: "When is your mother's birthday?" – Hỏi thời điểm sinh nhật dùng "When".

part_A.question: We use a television to ….
part_A.explanation: "a television" dùng để "watch films" (xem phim).

part_A.question: I don’t like singing so I hate … .
part_A.explanation: "hate" = ghét; không thích hát (singing) → ghét môn Âm nhạc (Music).

part_A.question: … is the weather like today? – It’s sunny.
part_A.explanation: "What is the weather like?" – Hỏi thời tiết; trả lời mô tả.

part_A.question: How’s ... weather today? - It’s hot today.
part_A.explanation: "the weather" – danh từ chỉ thời tiết luôn đi với "the".

part_A.question: Hi, how are you? – I’m very ..., thanks.
part_A.explanation: "I'm very well, thanks." – Trả lời "How are you?" bằng "I'm well."

part_A.question: What time …? – It’s four twenty.
part_A.explanation: "What time is it?" – Câu hỏi về giờ; đảo ngữ: "is it" (không phải "it is").

part_A.question: … My name is Alan. I’m eight … old.
part_A.explanation: Câu đặc biệt IOE: "Hello – years old" (Xin chào – ... tuổi).

part_A.question: What is your favourite ...? – I like milk very much.
part_A.explanation: "What is your favourite drink?" – Hỏi đồ uống yêu thích; "drink" = đồ uống.

part_A.question: What is the time? -… a quarter to ten.
part_A.explanation: "What is the time?" – Trả lời dùng "It's": "It's a quarter to ten."

part_A.question: Our family often has … quite late in the evening.
part_A.explanation: "have dinner" = ăn tối; "quite late in the evening" = khá muộn vào buổi tối.

part_A.question: My father tells me to buy two … of tea.
part_A.explanation: "a packet of tea" = một gói trà; số nhiều là "packets of tea".

part_A.question: Another word for ’’autumn’’ is ’’...’’.
part_A.explanation: "fall" là từ đồng nghĩa Anh-Mỹ của "autumn" (mùa thu).

part_A.question: What is your brother’s ...? - He likes playing toys.
part_A.explanation: "What is your brother's hobby?" – Hỏi sở thích; "hobby" = sở thích.

part_A.question: A: How … do you have IT? - B: I have it once a week.
part_A.explanation: "How often...?" – Hỏi tần suất; "once a week" = một lần một tuần.

part_A.question: What is your favourite …? – Spaghetti.
part_A.explanation: "What is your favourite food?" – Hỏi món ăn yêu thích; "food" = thức ăn.

part_A.question: Simon can … English and Vietnamese.
part_A.explanation: "speak + ngôn ngữ" = nói được tiếng gì: "speak English and Vietnamese."

part_A.question: Tommy can sp_ _ k Vietnamese.
part_A.explanation: "sp_eak_" → "speak" = nói; điền "ea". Tommy có thể nói tiếng Việt.

part_A.question: Who is she? - She is my s_ _ ter.
part_A.explanation: "s_is_ter" → "sister" = chị/em gái; điền "is". Câu hỏi "Who is she?"

part_A.question: This g_ _ t is for you. - Thank you.
part_A.explanation: "g_if_t" → "gift" = quà tặng; điền "if". "This gift is for you."

part_A.question: First, seco_ _ , third, fourth…
part_A.explanation: "seco_nd_" → "second" = thứ hai (số thứ tự); điền "nd".

part_A.question: Mary likes to read books in the school li_ _ ary.
part_A.explanation: "li_br_ary" → "library" = thư viện; điền "br". Mary thích đọc sách trong thư viện.

part_A.question: There are four peo_ _ e in my family.
part_A.explanation: "peo_pl_e" → "people" = người (số nhiều); điền "pl". "four people" = bốn người.

part_A.question: There is an era_ _ r on the desk.
part_A.explanation: "era_se_r" → "eraser" = cục tẩy; điền "se". "on the desk" = trên bàn.

part_A.question: Alice is my new f_ _ _ nd.
part_A.explanation: "f_rie_nd" → "friend" = bạn bè; điền "rie". "my new friend" = bạn mới.

part_A.question: Be care_ _ _ ! These stairs are wet.
part_A.explanation: "care_ful_" → "careful" = cẩn thận; điền "ful". "Be careful!" = Hãy cẩn thận!

part_A.question: What’s the d_ _ e today? It’s the first of November.
part_A.explanation: "d_at_e" → "date" = ngày tháng; điền "at". "What's the date today?" hỏi ngày hôm nay.

part_A.question: I’m h_ _ gry. I want some pizzas.
part_A.explanation: "h_un_gry" → "hungry" = đói; điền "un". "I'm hungry" = tôi đói.

part_A.question: Tony is fr_ _ Australia.
part_A.explanation: "fr_om_" → "from" = từ, đến từ; điền "om". "Tony is from Australia."

part_A.question: Hi, Linda. _ _ _ _ to meet you.
part_A.explanation: "_Nice_" → "Nice to meet you" = Rất vui được gặp bạn; điền "Nice".

part_A.question: Hi. I’m from Au_ _ ralia. And you?
part_A.explanation: "Au_st_ralia" → "Australia" = nước Úc; điền "st".

part_A.question: I’m th_ _ sty. I want some water.
part_A.explanation: "th_ir_sty" → "thirsty" = khát nước; điền "ir". "I'm thirsty" = tôi khát.

part_A.question: What is his _ _ _ ? – He is a singer.
part_A.explanation: "_job_" → "job" = công việc, nghề nghiệp; điền "job". "What is his job?"

part_A.question: Our class is doing exercise in the _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "_gym_" → "gym" = phòng tập thể dục; điền "gym". "doing exercise in the gym."

part_A.question: What does he do in the e_ _ nings?
part_A.explanation: "e_ve_nings" → "evenings" = buổi tối (số nhiều); điền "ve".

part_A.question: I’m so sor_ _ for being late today.
part_A.explanation: "sor_ry_" → "sorry" = xin lỗi; điền "ry". "I'm so sorry for being late."

part_A.question: This such a _ _ _ _ tiful dress.
part_A.explanation: "_beau_tiful" → "beautiful" = đẹp; điền "beau". "a beautiful dress" = chiếc váy đẹp.

part_A.question: These pre_ _ _ _ s are for you and your sister.
part_A.explanation: "pre_sent_s" → "presents" = quà tặng (số nhiều); điền "sent".

part_A.question: My pencils a_ _ yellow.
part_A.explanation: "a_re_" → "are" = là/có (số nhiều); điền "re". "My pencils are yellow."

part_A.question: A: What _ _ _ _ do you like? – B: Monday and Friday.
part_A.explanation: "_days_" → "days" = các ngày; điền "days". "What days do you like?"

part_A.question: We have a Music lesson on T_ _ _ day.
part_A.explanation: "T_ues_day" → "Tuesday" = thứ Ba; điền "ues".

part_A.question: There is o_ e bed in my bedroom.
part_A.explanation: "o_n_e" → "one" = một; điền "n". "There is one bed" = có một chiếc giường.

part_A.question: What _ _ _ _ is it, Huong? – It’s two o’clock now.
part_A.explanation: "_time_" → "time" = thời gian, giờ; điền "time". "What time is it?"

part_A.question: Mary Jane is her _ _ _ _ name.
part_A.explanation: "_full_ name" → "full name" = tên đầy đủ; điền "full".

part_A.question: Is she from S_ _ _ apore?
part_A.explanation: "S_ing_apore" → "Singapore" = đảo quốc Singapore; điền "ing".

part_A.question: Bring an um_ _ _ lla in case it may rain.
part_A.explanation: "um_bre_lla" → "umbrella" = ô dù; điền "bre". "in case it may rain" = phòng khi trời mưa.

part_A.question: The teacher is reading an dic_ _ _ _ _ _ for the class.
part_A.explanation: "dic_tation_" → "dictation" = bài nghe chép; điền "tation".

part_A.question: Is he str_ _ _ or weak?
part_A.explanation: "str_ong_" → "strong" = mạnh; điền "ong". Đối lập với "weak" = yếu.

part_A.question: Every week has se_ _ _ days.
part_A.explanation: "se_ven_" → "seven" = bảy; điền "ven". "Every week has seven days."

part_A.question: Who can cl_ _ _ a tree?
part_A.explanation: "cl_imb_" → "climb" = leo trèo; điền "imb". "climb a tree" = leo cây.

part_A.question: Her family n_ _ _ is Green.
part_A.explanation: "n_ame_" → "name" = tên; điền "ame". "family name" = họ.

part_A.question: What’s the _ _ _ _ _ _ ? – I’m sick.
part_A.explanation: "_matter_" → "matter" = vấn đề; điền "matter". "What's the matter?" = Có chuyện gì vậy?

part_A.question: Is that your new sch_ _ l? – Yes, it is.
part_A.explanation: "sch_oo_l" → "school" = trường học; điền "oo".

part_A.question: Can you s_ _ g a song? – Yes, I can.
part_A.explanation: "s_in_g" → "sing" = hát; điền "in". "sing a song" = hát một bài hát.

part_A.question: What s_ _ _ _ _ _ s do you like? – I like English and Music.
part_A.explanation: "s_ubject_s" → "subjects" = các môn học; điền "ubject".

part_A.question: We have Music lesson t_ _ _ _ a week.
part_A.explanation: "t_wice_" → "twice" = hai lần; điền "wice". "twice a week" = hai lần một tuần.

part_A.question: Tam: What is the w_ _ _ _ _ _ like in your town this season? - Hoa: It’s very cold.
part_A.explanation: "w_eather_" → "weather" = thời tiết; điền "eather". "What is the weather like?"

part_A.question: These fl_ _ ers are for you, Jane. – Thank you.
part_A.explanation: "fl_ow_ers" → "flowers" = những bông hoa; điền "ow".

part_A.question: It is often _ _ _ in summer.
part_A.explanation: "_hot_" → "hot" = nóng; điền "hot". "It is often hot in summer."

part_A.question: Goodbye. See you to_ _ rrow.
part_A.explanation: "to_mo_rrow" → "tomorrow" = ngày mai; điền "mo". "See you tomorrow!"

part_A.question: Sit on that _ _ air, please.
part_A.explanation: "_ch_air" → "chair" = ghế; điền "ch". "Sit on that chair, please."

part_A.question: We a_ _ having a break.
part_A.explanation: "a_re_" → "are" = (to be số nhiều); điền "re". "We are having a break."

part_A.question: My brother and my sister never stay up l_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "l_ate_" → "late" = muộn; điền "ate". "stay up late" = thức khuya.

part_A.question: I pl_ _ badminton every Monday.
part_A.explanation: "pl_ay_" → "play" = chơi/đánh; điền "ay". "play badminton" = đánh cầu lông.

part_A.question: Can you come and s_ _ _ a song with me?
part_A.explanation: "s_ing_" → "sing" = hát; điền "ing". "sing a song with me" = hát cùng tôi.

part_A.question: Put your _ _ nds down, children.
part_A.explanation: "_ha_nds" → "hands" = bàn tay (số nhiều); điền "ha".

part_A.question: Today is Tu_ _ day so I go to school.
part_A.explanation: "Tu_es_day" → "Tuesday" = thứ Ba; điền "es".

part_A.question: My school is in Tran Hung Dao R_ _ d.
part_A.explanation: "R_oa_d" → "Road" = đường phố; điền "oa". Tên đường: Tran Hung Dao Road.

part_A.question: Monday, Tuesday, W_ _ nesday, Thursday…
part_A.explanation: "W_ed_nesday" → "Wednesday" = thứ Tư; điền "ed".

part_A.question: What _ _ you do on Fridays?
part_A.explanation: "_do_" → "do" (trợ động từ); điền "do". "What do you do on Fridays?"

part_A.question: The weath_ _ is cloudy today.
part_A.explanation: "weath_er_" → "weather" = thời tiết; điền "er". "The weather is cloudy."

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ pens are there on the desk?
part_A.explanation: "_many_" → "many" = nhiều (đếm được); điền "many". "How many pens...?"

part_A.question: This is a yell_ _ pillow.
part_A.explanation: "yell_ow_" → "yellow" = màu vàng; điền "ow". "a yellow pillow" = chiếc gối vàng.

part_A.question: What is the w_ _ _ _ _ _ like in your town this season? – It’s warm.
part_A.explanation: "w_eather_" → "weather" = thời tiết; điền "eather". "What is the weather like?"

part_A.question: Do_ _ your mother like swimming?
part_A.explanation: "Do_es_" → "Does" (trợ động từ ngôi 3 số ít); điền "es". "Does your mother like...?"

part_A.question: That’s my fa_ _ er. His name is Peter.
part_A.explanation: "fa_th_er" → "father" = bố; điền "th". "That's my father."

part_A.question: It’s rai_ _ in Ho Chi Minh city today.
part_A.explanation: "rai_ny_" → "rainy" = mưa; điền "ny". "It's rainy in Ho Chi Minh city."

part_A.question: Can she p_ _ y football? – No, she can’t.
part_A.explanation: "p_la_y" → "play" = chơi; điền "la". "Can she play football? – No, she can't."

part_A.question: English and Music are my favourite _ _ _ _ _ cts.
part_A.explanation: "_subje_cts" → "subjects" = các môn học; điền "subje".

part_A.question: Let’s make a c_ _ _ le.
part_A.explanation: "c_irc_le" → "circle" = vòng tròn; điền "irc". "Let's make a circle."

part_A.question: Let’s go out for _ _ _ ner.
part_A.explanation: "_din_ner" → "dinner" = bữa tối; điền "din". "Let's go out for dinner."

part_A.question: Her birthday is in Ap_ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: "Ap_ril_" → "April" = tháng Tư; điền "ril". "birthday is in April."

part_A.question: cook / Let's / meal. / big / a /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Let's cook a big meal." – "Let's + V" = đề nghị cùng làm gì.

part_A.question: Open / your / please. / books, /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Open your books, please." – Mệnh lệnh lịch sự: Open + tân ngữ + please.

part_A.question: Mr. / Parker. / evening, / Good /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Good evening, Mr. Parker." – Lời chào buổi tối; "Mr." = ông.

part_A.question: after / “Computer”. / me: / Read /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Read after me: 'Computer'." – Mệnh lệnh: Read after me = đọc theo tôi.

part_A.question: birthday? / your / When / is /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "When is your birthday?" – Câu hỏi: When + is + chủ ngữ.

part_A.question: am / I / hungry / now. /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "I am hungry now." – Chủ ngữ + am + tính từ + now.

part_A.question: Ron / is / from / England. /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Ron is from England." – Chủ ngữ + is from + quốc gia.

part_A.question: in / live / London. / They /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "They live in London." – Chủ ngữ + live in + thành phố.

part_A.question: you want / I don’t. / to go / fishing? – No, / Do /
part_A.answer: Do you want to go fishing? – No, I don’t.
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Do you want to go fishing? – No, I don't." – Câu hỏi Yes/No.

part_A.question: I / football / today. / play /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "I play football today." – Chủ ngữ + play + môn thể thao.

part_A.question: is / Kate / pretty. / Miss /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Miss Kate is pretty." – Chủ ngữ + is + tính từ.

part_A.question: English. / am / I / not /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "I am not English." – Chủ ngữ + am not + quốc tịch.

part_A.question: I / not / Malaysian. / am /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "I am not Malaysian." – Chủ ngữ + am not + quốc tịch.

part_A.question: baseball? / Can / play / you /
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Can you play baseball?" – Can + chủ ngữ + động từ nguyên thể?

part_A.question: go / club. / Let's / to / the music /
part_A.answer: Let's go to the music club.
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Let's go to the music club." – "Let's go to" + địa điểm.

part_A.question: with / help / your bags? / Can I / you /
part_A.answer: Can I help you with your bags?
part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Can I help you with your bags?" – Câu xin phép/đề nghị giúp đỡ.
